name: Perspective Parallax Carousel
description: Full-screen image slider shown as a folded 3D triptych: a flat center panel with two angled side panels, all sliding together as the pointer moves horizontally across the screen.
contents: Three perspective panels (center and two angled sides) showing the same image strip
Optional hint line at the bottom
behavior: Pointer position across the window maps to the slide position, with eased 500ms transitions
Side panels are rotated in 3D around the center panel edges
Touch dragging also moves the slides
editableByProps: Background and hint text color, hint text
Perspective depth, side panel angle, starting slide, horizontal dead zone

needsCodeEdit.where: w-[60vw] h-[80vh] classes on the three pane divs
duration-500 ease-out classes on the track divs

fixed: Listens to pointer movement on the whole window
Horizontal padding is capped to a quarter of the width on narrow screens
